example.translationZh: 这所飞行学校聘请了两名新教员来培训学员。

example.translationZh: 她会演奏三种乐器，但最喜欢的是小提琴。

definitionEn:

example.translationZh: 音乐会开始前，管弦乐队为乐器调了音。

example.translationZh: 墙壁做了隔热层以防止热量流失。

example.text: He forgot her birthday and then laughed at her for being upset, adding insult to injury.
example.translationZh: 他忘了她的生日，还嘲笑她为此难过，简直是雪上加霜。

phrase.translationZh: 雪上加霜；在已受伤害的情况下再添侮辱

definitionEn: n. promise of reimbursement in the case of loss; paid to people or companies so concerned about hazards that they have made prepayments to an insurance company
definitionZh: n. 保险, 保险业, 保险费\n[医] 保险

example.text: She bought health insurance before starting her new job.
example.translationZh: 她在开始新工作之前买了健康保险。

definitionEn: v. take out insurance for
definitionZh: vt. 保险, 确保\nvi. 投保

example.translationZh: 他们决定给房子投保火灾和盗窃险。

definitionEn: s. (of a woman) having the hymen unbroken\ns. undamaged in any way

example.text: Despite the earthquake, the ancient temple remained intact.
example.translationZh: 尽管发生了地震，这座古庙仍然完好无损。

definitionEn: n knowledge and intellectual ability\nn the capacity for rational thought or inference or discrimination\nn a person who uses the mind creatively

example.translationZh: 她不仅因才智而受人钦佩，也因善良而受人称赞。

definitionEn: n. a person who uses the mind creatively\ns. of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind\na. appealing to or using the intellect
definitionZh: n. 有知识者, 知识分子, 凭理智做事者\na. 智力的, 用脑力的, 聪明的

example.text: The author hired a lawyer to protect her intellectual property before publishing the novel.
example.translationZh: 这位作者在出版小说之前聘请了一位律师来保护她的知识产权。

definitionEn:
n. the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience
n. a unit responsible for gathering and interpreting information about an enemy
n. secret information about an enemy (or potential enemy)

definitionZh: n. 智力, 情报, 信息\n[医] 智力

example.text: The company invests heavily in artificial intelligence research.
example.translationZh: 这家公司在人工智能研究上投入巨资。

definitionEn: a. well articulated or enunciated, and loud enough to be heard distinctly
definitionZh: a. 可理解的, 易理解的, 纯概念性的

example.text: The professor's lecture was intelligible even to students without a background in linguistics.
example.translationZh: 这位教授的讲座即使对没有语言学背景的学生来说也清晰易懂。

definitionEn: v. make more intense, stronger, or more marked\nv. become more intense\nv. make the chemically affected part of (a negative) denser or more opaque in order produce a stronger contrast between light and dark
definitionZh: vt. 加强\nvi. 强化

example.text: The government plans to intensify its efforts to reduce air pollution in major cities.
example.translationZh: 政府计划加大力度减少大城市的空气污染。

definitionEn: s. characterized by a high degree or intensity; often used as a combining form\na. tending to give force or emphasis\na. of agriculture; intended to increase productivity of a fixed area by expending more capital and labor

example.text: The patient was moved to intensive care after the accident.
example.translationZh: 事故发生后，病人被转入重症监护室。

definitionEn: n. the intended meaning of a communication
definitionZh: n. 意图, 含义, 故意\na. 专心的, 决心的, 热心的

example.text: The court found that she had entered the building with intent to steal.
example.translationZh: 法庭认定她进入大楼是蓄意偷窃。

definitionEn:
n. a sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something
n. the power of attracting or holding one's attention (because it is unusual or exciting etc.)

example.translationZh: 她对环境问题非常感兴趣。

definitionEn: n. the time between one event, process, or period and another\ns. serving during an intermediate interval of time
definitionZh: a. 暂时的, 临时的, 间歇的\nn. 过渡时期

example.text: The new manager will take over in June, and until then the deputy director is in charge in the interim.
example.translationZh: 新经理将在六月接手，在那之前由副主管在此期间负责。

definitionEn: a. situated within or suitable for inside a building\ns. inside and toward a center\ns. of or coming from the middle of a region or country
definitionZh: n. 内部, 内政\na. 内部的, 心灵的, 内地的, 内政的

example.text: The hotel's interior design combines modern comfort with traditional charm.
example.translationZh: 这家酒店的室内设计将现代舒适与传统魅力融为一体。

definitionEn: s. stopping and starting at irregular intervals
definitionZh: a. 间歇的, 断断续续的\n[化] 间歇的; 间断的

example.text: The weather forecast warned of intermittent rain throughout the afternoon.
example.translationZh: 天气预报提醒整个下午会有间歇性降雨。

definitionEn: n. any of several international socialist organizations\na. concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations

example.translationZh: 这家公司去年拓展了国际贸易业务。

definitionEn: n. a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange
definitionZh: [计] 因特网, 国际互连网, 网际网络, 互连网络, 广域网

example.text: She spends an hour surfing the internet every evening to catch up on the news.
example.translationZh: 她每天晚上花一个小时上网了解新闻。

example.translationZh: 侦探们轮流就该嫌疑人当晚的行踪对他进行讯问。

definitionZh: n. 交集, 十字路口, 交叉点\n[计] 逻辑乘; 与

example.translationZh: 在下一个十字路口左转。

example.translationZh: 这位面试者冷静而自信地回答了每一个问题。

example.translationZh: 面试官让她描述一个她在工作中解决过的难题。

example.translationZh: 消息传出后，办公室被忧心忡忡的顾客打来的电话淹没了。
